claims.claim: Narrator describes Tarry Town on the Hudson and Sleepy Hollow
Sleepy Hollow is haunted by a headless Hessian trooper
claims.evidence: 'the ghost of a Hessian trooper, whose head had been carried away by a cannon-ball'

claims.claim: He then introduces the lanky schoolmaster Ichabod Crane

claims.evidence: 'No tale was too gross or monstrous for his capacious swallow'

claims.claim: Ichabod is greedy / hopes for father's wealth
claims.evidence: 'scene of rural wealth, on which he had so often gloated'; Katrina 'her vast expectations'

claims.claim: Katrina is daughter of a rich Dutch farmer
claims.evidence: 'daughter and only child of a substantial Dutch farmer'

claims.claim: Brom Bones is his rowdy rival
claims.evidence: 'burly, roaring, roystering blade ... Brom Van Brunt'

claims.claim: Party at the Van Tassels'; ghost stories
claims.evidence: stories of Doffue Martling, Brom and the Galloping Hessian

claims.claim: Ichabod rides home at night and meets a headless rider who hurls his head
claims.evidence: 'the goblin rising in his stirrups, and in the very act of hurling his head at him'

claims.claim: Next morning only hat and shattered pumpkin found
claims.evidence: 'found the saddle trampled in the dirt ... was found the hat ... and close beside it a shattered pumpkin'
claims.fix: trampled saddle found, and by the brook his hat beside a shattered pumpkin

claims.claim: Never seen again in the Hollow; villagers suppose the ghost carried him off
claims.evidence: 'came to the conclusion that Ichabod had been carried off by the Galloping Hessian'

claims.claim: An old farmer reports he is alive elsewhere
claims.evidence: 'brought home the intelligence that Ichabod Crane was still alive'

claims.claim: Brom marries Katrina and laughs at mention of the pumpkin
claims.evidence: 'conducted the blooming Katrina in triumph to the altar ... always burst into a hearty laugh at the mention of the pumpkin'

claims.claim: Ichabod is from Connecticut, lean, superstitious

claims.evidence: 'plump as a partridge ... a little of a coquette'

claims.claim: Brom Bones is Abraham Van Brunt
Baltus Van Tassel is Katrina's wealthy father
claims.evidence: 'Old Baltus Van Tassel ... satisfied with his wealth'

claims.claim: Headless Horseman is the Galloping Hessian
